def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    moves={1:(-1,2),2:(0,-4),3:(3,0),6:(-6,0)}
    pts=[(r,c,a[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if a[r][c] in moves]
    for r,c,v in pts:
        dr,dc=moves[v]; rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        sr=0 if dr==0 else (1 if dr>0 else -1)
        sc=0 if dc==0 else (1 if dc>0 else -1)
        # traverse horizontal then vertical
        x,y=r,c
        while y!=cc:
          y+=sc
          if (x,y)!=(rr,cc): a[x][y]=5
        while x!=rr:
          x+=sr
          if (x,y)!=(rr,cc): a[x][y]=5
        a[rr][cc]=v
    return a
